annotations.title: CFA Member Insurance - California Faculty Association
Health Insurance (Individual) | CFA Insurance Agency, LLC

content.text:
Did you mean **CFA Institute**?

**CFA Institute** is the global professional organization that administers the **CFA® Program** and awards the **Chartered Financial Analyst** designation. It focuses on investment management, financial analysis, ethics, and professional standards. ([cfainstitute.org](https://www.cfainstitute.org/?utm_source=openai))

If by **“cfa ins”** you meant something else, possible matches include:

- **CFA Institute** — finance/investment credential organization.
- **CFA Insurance Programs** — insurance benefits for California Faculty Association members. ([calfac.org](https://www.calfac.org/cfa-member-insurance/?utm_source=openai))
- **CFA Insurance Agency** — an insurance agency offering health insurance help. ([cfainsurance.com](https://www.cfainsurance.com/health-insurance-individual?utm_source=openai))
- **Cooperative Finance Association, Inc.** — agricultural/cooperative finance lender. ([cfafs.com](https://cfafs.com/?utm_source=openai))

Tell me what you’re trying to find—exam info, login, insurance, membership, or something else—and I can help.
